title: Record manifest digests per image name for precise RepoDigests
body:
Related to #67. This PR does not close it: `Image.Digest`, `inspect .Digest` and `images --digests` do not change.

This is the design from https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/issues/67#issuecomment-5837941899, after the review there. It is a draft, so you can see it work before a full review.

#### What changes

- **c/storage:** `Image.NameDigests` (`name-digests` in `images.json`) records, per image, the manifest digests that each name was committed with. The new `Store.AddImageNameWithDigests` moves the name and writes the record in one save. It works on images only.
- **c/image:** a commit records the per-platform manifest digest. When the top-level manifest is a list, it also records the list digest.
- **c/common:** `RepoDigests()` pairs a name with its recorded digests that the image still has. Without such a digest, it keeps the current "all digests" pairing.

#### Record lifecycle

- A pull that moves `repo:latest` to a different image keeps the record on the old image, so the old image still reports `repo@digestA`.
- The record goes away when the image is deleted.
- `RemoveNames` (untag) and `SetNames` drop the record of a removed name.
- `AddNames` (`podman tag`) drops the record of a name that is new on that image, so an old record from before a move does not come back. That name then uses the "all digests" pairing.
- A pull-up from a read-only image store keeps the records.

#### Pull test

I built Podman `main` against this branch and pulled from a local registry. I compared it with Podman 6.1.3.

| Scenario | Podman 6.1.3 | This branch |
|---|---|---|
| `repo:latest` pulled twice, gzip then zstd manifest, same image ID | both digests | zstd digest only |
| `repo:latest` moves from image A to image B | A loses `repo@…` | A keeps `repo@digestA`, B has `repo@digestB` |
| multi-platform list, amd64 then arm64 | arm64: list and arm64 digests | each image: its own platform digest and the list digest |
| pull by digest, then by tag | also lists the list digest of a different repository | only the pulled digest |

Podman `main` needs three small updates to build against current container-libs `main`. They come from d2506b3828 and 1550737217, not from this PR.

#### Not done

- I did not run the multi-arch tests in Podman `test/e2e/pull_test.go`.
- A new `storage.Store` method breaks external implementations of that interface, as discussed in the issue.
